This section contains an overview of course policies, at a higher level of detail than what is in the [syllabus](../syllabus.qmd).

- [Grading Policies](grading.qmd) --- how work is graded, late work, extensions, and regrade requests.
- [Practice Set Policies](practice-sets.qmd) --- what practice sets are for, and how they are marked.
- [Mini Project and Term Project Policies](projects.qmd) --- logistics for the computational work.
- [Quiz Policies](quiz.qmd) --- logistics, topics, accommodations, and conflicts.
- [Academic Integrity](integrity.qmd) --- collaboration, citation, and the AI/ML resource policy.
- [Grading Rubrics](rubric.qmd) --- the meta-rubric applied across written work.
- [Group Work](groups.qmd) --- expectations for pairs on mini projects and the term project.
